sources.location: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=EXT_ID:28508642 (PMID 28508642, abstract only; full text not open access)
python -m tools cellline lookup HeLa|LNCaP|Jurkat (CVCL_0030, CVCL_0395, CVCL_0065)

claims.value: 20 RAW files (RB_151029_Hela_1-3, CJK_150824_Hela_4h_3, RB_160123_LNCap_1-4, 12 TTT_*Jurkat* files)
claims.evidence: PRIDE file list: 20 RAW, plus .mgf peak lists and F0*.dat Mascot results. Each RAW claimed exactly once.
Abstract: in-solution digests of LNCaP and HeLa; phosphoproteomes of Jurkat T cells. Cell line assigned from run names.
Taken from Cellosaurus, not from the deposit. Disease uses the Cellosaurus disease label.
Cultured cell lines; reconcile flags a tissue value as unsupported, so a sentinel is written.

claims.value: cisplatin (Jurkat Cis/Cisplatin runs); not applicable otherwise
claims.evidence: Abstract: control vs apoptotic Jurkat phosphoproteomes. Run names 'Cisplatin'/'Cis' vs 'control'/'K'; reading Cis = cisplatin-induced apoptosis and K = control is an inference from names.
Inferred from file numbering and R3/R4/1st tags in run names; no deposited mapping.

claims.value: 1 = 25 NCE, 2 = 35 NCE for Jurkat; blank for HeLa/LNCaP
claims.evidence: Run names HCD25/HCD35 and 25NCE/35NCE; same sample acquired at two collision energies. Treated as technical replicates. HeLa/LNCaP collision energy not stated (not available).
PRIDE instruments field and consistent with HCD NCE settings.
Mascot search of MS/MS peak lists; DDA is assumed from the workflow, not stated explicitly.
dataProcessingProtocol lists only these two as variable modifications. Fixed Carbamidomethyl and Phospho (for phosphoproteome runs) are not stated and not annotated.
Inferred from HCD in Jurkat run names and NCE settings on a Q Exactive; assumed for HeLa/LNCaP.

limitations: Full text of PMID 28508642 not read (not open access); only abstract used.
Raw files and Mascot .dat headers were not inspected.
Treatment mapping (K = control, Cis = cisplatin) and biological replicate numbers are inferred from file names.
CJK_150824_Hela_4h_3 meaning of '4h' unknown; treated as a fourth HeLa digest.
Phosphopeptide enrichment of Jurkat samples not annotated (no verified term for characteristics[enrichment process]); Phospho and Carbamidomethyl modifications not annotated because not stated.
